"""Read-only lossless storage forecast on completed V184 native arrays."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,sys,time,zlib
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import numpy as np
R=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');Q=R/'.cache/quality-20261107/V185-native-storage-forecast-v1'
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def ref(p):
 p=Path(p).absolute()
 with p.open('rb') as f:h=hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
 return {'path':str(p),'sha256':h}
def save(p,x):
 with p.open('x') as f:json.dump(x,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
assert not Q.exists();Q.mkdir();os.nice(10);os.sched_setaffinity(0,[6,7])
new_path=R/'.cache/quality-20261107/V184-wave-readout-trial-v1/scores-v1.json'
new=read(new_path);plan=read(R/'.cache/quality-20261107/V184-wave-readout-trial-v1/plan-v1.json')
base=read(plan['baseline_scores']['path'])
rows=[];started=time.time()
for cid,bindings in new['native_predictions'].items():
 b=base['native_predictions'][cid]['V183-coherent-pair-EMA'];assert ref(b['path'])==b
 baseline=np.load(b['path'],allow_pickle=False)
 for endpoint in ['raw','EMA']:
  for kind,label in [('RGB',f'V184-wave-readout-{endpoint}'),('wave',f'V184-wave-readout-{endpoint}-wave')]:
   binding=bindings[label];assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
   value=np.load(binding['path'],allow_pickle=False);assert value.dtype==np.float32 and value.flags.c_contiguous
   raw=value.tobytes();shuffled=value.view(np.uint8).reshape(-1,4).T.copy().tobytes()
   choices={'zlib_raw':raw,'zlib_byteplanes':shuffled}
   if kind=='RGB':
    assert value.shape==baseline.shape
    xor=np.bitwise_xor(value.view(np.uint32),baseline.view(np.uint32))
    choices['zlib_baseline_xor_byteplanes']=xor.view(np.uint8).reshape(-1,4).T.copy().tobytes()
   sizes={}
   for name,payload in choices.items():
    compressed=zlib.compress(payload,6);decoded=zlib.decompress(compressed);assert decoded==payload
    if name=='zlib_raw':restored=np.frombuffer(decoded,np.float32).reshape(value.shape)
    else:
     restored=np.frombuffer(decoded,np.uint8).reshape(4,-1).T.copy().view(np.uint32).reshape(value.shape)
     if name=='zlib_baseline_xor_byteplanes':restored=np.bitwise_xor(restored,baseline.view(np.uint32))
     restored=restored.view(np.float32)
    assert restored.tobytes()==raw
    sizes[name]=len(compressed)
   rows.append({'id':cid,'endpoint':endpoint,'kind':kind,'original':binding,'array_bytes':value.nbytes,
                'shape':list(value.shape),'sizes':sizes,'all_decoded_bits_exact':True})
totals={name:sum(r['sizes'].get(name,0) for r in rows) for name in ['zlib_raw','zlib_byteplanes','zlib_baseline_xor_byteplanes']}
selected=sum(r['sizes']['zlib_baseline_xor_byteplanes' if r['kind']=='RGB' else 'zlib_byteplanes'] for r in rows)
result={'status':'pass-read-only-lossless-native-storage-forecast-not-new-quality','created_local':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('America/Los_Angeles')).isoformat(),
 'source':dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'completed_scores':ref(new_path),'baseline_scores':plan['baseline_scores'],
 'rows':rows,'arrays':len(rows),'original_array_bytes':sum(r['array_bytes'] for r in rows),'compressed_totals':totals,
 'selected_RGB_xor_plus_wave_byteplanes_bytes':selected,'forecast_with_35_percent_margin_and_1KiB_per_array':int(selected*1.35)+len(rows)*1024,
 'all_array_bits_roundtrip_exact':True,'new_neural_forwards':0,'new_sensor_source_draws':0,'seconds':time.time()-started,
 'scope':'Read completed V184 RGB/wave and V183 EMA baseline arrays only;no original/checkpoint/source array modified. All channels roundtrip exactly in memory including signed zero. Selected prospective format uses bitwise XOR RGB against immutable baseline,then byte-plane transpose and zlib6;wave uses byte-plane transpose and zlib6. Compressed payloads not retained;compact forecast only. Future method entropy can differ;35percent margin is a forecast,not bound.'}
assert 'torch' not in sys.modules and 'rawpy' not in sys.modules
save(Q/'result-v1.json',result)
print('PASS',len(rows),'arrays;originalMiB',result['original_array_bytes']/2**20,'selectedMiB',selected/2**20,'forecastMiB',result['forecast_with_35_percent_margin_and_1KiB_per_array']/2**20,flush=True)
